stem.text: The graph shows how the length of a spring varies with the force applied to it. Two areas P and Q are labelled.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled length and horizontal axis labelled force. A straight line rises from a point on the vertical axis above the origin. Dashed lines mark a horizontal line from the vertical axis and a vertical line at the end of the rising line; the regions are labelled P and Q.

stem.text: Which area represents the work done in stretching the spring?
